mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, b.buyer_name, p.product_name, c.category_name, s.shop_name, a.address_detail, t.transport_type FROM t_order o INNER JOIN t_buyer b ON o.buyer_id = b.id INNER JOIN t_order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN t_product p ON oi.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN t_category c ON p.category_id = c.id INNER JOIN t_shop s ON p.shop_id = s.id INNER JOIN t_address a ON b.address_id = a.id INNER JOIN t_transport t ON o.transport_id = t.id WHERE o.del_flag = 0
